title: Product smoke and real harness checks
summary: Windows and macOS product smoke and full-suite workflows run only on demand. Product smoke has Ubuntu x86, Ubuntu arm, macOS and Windows legs; Windows proves candidate wheel installation and yoke status, while macOS and Linux also exercise onboarding, hooks and source development. There is no per-PR Windows check or required Windows merge-queue context. Targeted Windows source tests still use literal pytest.mark.windows declarations and skip unmarked modules before import; the on-demand full suite runs every test with shrink-only known-failure baselines.
